name: 2-1:Infernal Cavern
short:
A cave has been
found beneath
Ragol. Go and
investigate.
long:
Client: Principal
Quest:
 A network of
 subterranean caverns
 has been found under
 the surface of Ragol.
 Please investigate.
※ Job can be joined
 while in progress.

Oh, <name hero>!
You're here!

I'm very glad that
you've come.

It was just reported to
me that a series of caves
was found on Ragol.

Of course, Pioneer 1 had
never mentioned these
in any of their reports.

We still cannot get into
the Central Dome itself,
so we're at an impasse...

Our only choice is to
send search teams down
into those caverns.

Perhaps we may even find
survivors from Pioneer 1
in there...

Please. I would like you
to join the search team,
if you would.

My secretary, Irene, has
the details. Please speak
to her.
...I'm counting on you.

Please speak to Irene,
my secretary.

No one's really explored
these caves. So please be
very careful down there.

There were creatures that
you've never seen before?

How are such abominations
living beneath Ragol?!
Why didn't anyone know?

Please, continue your
investigation.

How did it go,
<name hero>?
Hm...
I see.

There are numerous
underground magma tunnels
throughout Ragol.

And these unidentified
creatures that live
within them...

Pioneer 1 simply had
to have known about
these caverns!
Or, perhaps...

Well, it's best not to
speculate.

We need to investigate
this matter more
thoroughly.

I may call upon you for
your services again,
<name hero>.

Until then, please,
go and get some rest.

I may call upon your
services again,
<name hero>.

Until then, please,
go and get some rest.

Where do you think you're
going?

You haven't spoken with
Irene for the details,
yet!

Allow me to explain the
details of this next
mission.

Orders are to check out
the caverns discovered
beneath Ragol's surface.

We don't know where or
how far they lead, so
please investigate.

A teleporter has been
set to take you to the
caverns' entrance.

You can get there
directly from the city,
now.

Unfortunately, we know
next to nothing about
what's down there.

Please, be extremely
careful.
That is all.
Good luck.
Oh, also...

About the Principal's
daughter, Red Ring Rico:

Please tell me anything
you discover regarding
her whereabouts.
Thank you very much.

Bizarre hostile creatures
are down there, you say?

I guess that the people
of Pioneer 1 wouldn't
have taken shelter there.

The Principal is waiting.
Please give him your
report.
Welcome back!

So, there are monsters
living underneath 
Ragol's surface.

What we thought we knew,
and this investigation
just isn't adding up.

The Pioneer 1 crew were
all very capable
individuals.

It's either got to be a
huge mistake, or they
were hiding something.

With the data we have
now, I can't say anything
conclusive!
It's so frustrating!

I'm sorry. Please,
forgive me!

You should go and
rest up, for now.

We'll call on you again
when needed.

Why don't you go and
relax for now?

You've already finished
this quest.

Please select "Cancel" at
the Counter to return to
the Lobby.

Caves underneath the
surface of Ragol?

I wonder what could be
down there…

Hmm...
How curious!

There simply isn't any
data about these new
creatures you've found.

I don't see how the
Pioneer 1 crew could have
possibly missed them…

There are caverns that
lead beneath Ragol's
surface?

Maybe the people from
Pioneer 1 took refuge
in there, then?

The creatures inside the
caverns were hostile,
too?!

And no one's been able to
identify them?

Isn't there any place on
that damned planet that's
safe for us?

It seems that you cannot
go any further.

It seems that you cannot
go any further.
